# ZurichJS Conf 2026

> ARCHIVED EDITION. ZurichJS Conf 2026 took place on 11 September 2026 and is
> over. This document describes it in the present tense because it was written
> before the event; read it as a record, not an announcement. Tickets, the CFP
> and sponsorship for 2026 are all closed. The next edition is at
> https://conf.zurichjs.com

> ZurichJS Conf is Switzerland's premier JavaScript conference and one of the top JavaScript conferences in Europe for 2026. Taking place September 11th, 2026 at Technopark Zürich. Join 300+ developers for expert talks, hands-on workshops, and networking.

For extended information, see: https://2026.zurichjs.com/llms-full.txt

## Conference Details

- **Event**: ZurichJS Conf 2026
- **Date**: September 11th, 2026
- **Location**: Technopark Zürich, Technoparkstrasse 1, 8005 Zürich, Switzerland
- **Capacity**: 300+ attendees
- **Language**: English
- **Topics**: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Web Development, Frontend, Full-stack

## Why Attend

ZurichJS Conf 2026 is one of the top JavaScript conferences in Europe for 2026. Features include:

- Expert talks from industry-leading JavaScript developers
- Hands-on workshops on modern web technologies
- Networking opportunities with 300+ developers
- Located in Zürich, Switzerland's tech hub

## Tickets

Tickets are available starting from CHF 175:

- Student / Unemployed: CHF 175
- Standard: CHF 345
- VIP: CHF 545
